judge-strict-editor: Read the JSON file docs/validation/evidence/f4s_pool_blind.json (279 pairs from the edit history of Finnish Wikipedia articles: id, page, section, an 'old' paragraph and a 'new' paragraph from a later revision of the same article). Judge each pair on its own, strictly; do not default to either answer; ids carry no information.  QUESTION: is the new paragraph the same paragraph as the old one after editing? same=true only if most of the old paragraph's content survives in the new one AND the new paragraph is mainly about the same subject (it may be reworded, corrected, extended, shortened, or have sentences added or removed). same=false if the new paragraph is mainly about something else, if only one sentence, a name or a short trailing part is shared, or if the old content is mostly gone.
judge-history-reader: Read the JSON file docs/validation/evidence/f4s_pool_blind.json (279 pairs from the edit history of Finnish Wikipedia articles: id, page, section, an 'old' paragraph and a 'new' paragraph from a later revision of the same article). Judge each pair on its own, strictly; do not default to either answer; ids carry no information.  QUESTION: a reader is shown the history of the old paragraph. Would they be misled if the tool presented the new paragraph as its next version? same=true only if presenting it as the next version is faithful: the new paragraph carries the old paragraph's main statements, in any wording or with additions. same=false if it would mislead: the main statements changed to different ones, a different event or topic, or the overlap is a fragment of either paragraph.
